tis2_content.tis2_content:
Precise fingerprint recognition
Grip the handle and it unlocks
tis2_content.tis2_content2: A Swedish FPC live-fingerprint sensor and advanced recognition read fingerprints with high precision. The sensor is hidden in the handle, right under your thumb: a light grip unlocks the door. Passcodes, remote authorization from your phone and a backup key cover every other situation.
tis3_content.tis3_content2:
T1C won a 2019 Red Dot Award. Its two classic finishes were tuned hundreds of times by an internationally awarded design team.
Understated, deep Basalt Black or traditional, elegant Copper Gold: both suit every kind of door and any style.
tis4_content.tis4_content:
Lock status at a glance
Alerts the moment it matters
tis4_content.tis4_content2: No more wondering “Did I lock the door?”. 8 built-in sensors detect whether the door is open, closed or locked; check the lock's status live in the app and get an alert as soon as anything is wrong.
tis5_content.tis5_content: Certified by the 360 Security Lab, bank-grade protection
tis5_content.tis5_content2: White-hat hacking tests in 360's IoT ecosystem protection program and strict lab testing lower the risk of hackers and malware, and guard against cloned fingerprint IDs, forged passcode commands and electromagnetic “black box” attacks, for real peace of mind.
tis6_content.tis6_content2: The fingerprint module knows who is unlocking, so you hear the moment a family member gets home. Set personal scenes too: through a smart gateway the lock talks to the rest of your smart home, so each family member's fingerprint can start a different scene across the whole house.
install_sec1.install_sec1: Fits mainstream standard doors, installs without drilling
install_sec1.install_sec12: The standard 6068 format fits over 95% of standard-size wooden and security doors, and the standard 23.5 cm hole spacing lets it replace a traditional lock without new holes. Optimized internal wiring links the inner and outer units with a single cable, so it is easy to install.
